mechanism_narrative: When the FEDFUNDS rate rises by more than 0.25% over the next month, investors anticipate higher future inflation, which lowers real equity valuations and produces negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > (current value + 0.25%) in the following month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero during the identified FEDFUNDS rise (p > 0.05), or FEDFUNDS rise < 0.25% in practice.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in PAYEMS (employment growth) of at least 50,000 jobs over two consecutive months is associated with stronger consumer demand, which drives positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by ≥50,000 for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative despite the two-month PAYEMS acceleration (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When GDPC1 (real private consumption) grows faster than CPIAUCSL (CPI) in the prior quarter, it indicates demand outpacing inflation, which predicts positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth > CPIAUCSL growth in the previous quarter
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically positive when the condition holds (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in INDPRO (industrial production) index by 5% or more over a month is a leading indicator of supply-side weakness, which tends to produce negative 5-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < (previous value * 0.95) in the following month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not negative when INDPRO declines by ≥5% (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a regime of persistent FEDFUNDS > 4%, the 20-day S&P 500 forward return is expected to be negative due to higher real borrowing costs compressing equity valuations.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in the identified regime (p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in UNRATE (unemployment) below 4% triggers optimism about labor market tightness, which predicts positive 5-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 4% in the following trading day
failure_condition: 5-day forward return is not positive when UNRATE crosses below 4% (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When HOUST (housing starts) rises by 10% in the next two months, it signals rebuilding confidence in the housing market, which supports positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases by ≥10% over the next two months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during the HOUST acceleration (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive months of RSAFS (retail sales) below trend (index < 100) indicate weak consumer demand, which predicts negative 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not negative when RSAFS lags trend (p > 0.05).
